## Add New Project

> **Auto-generated PR?** If this PR was opened by `issue-to-project.yml`, the fields below
> are already populated — just review and merge.
>
> **Manual PR?** Fill in the table below before requesting review.

### Repository Information

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Project name** (directory name) | `my_project` |
| **GitHub Repo URL** | `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>` |
| **Status** | `In Progress` / `Planned` / `On Hold` / `Completed` |
| **Period** | `YYYY-MM-DD - YYYY-MM-DD` |

> Minimum required: `Repo`, `Status`, `Period`.  
> `Notes` and `Last Updated` are auto-populated from the linked repo after merge.

---

### Checklist

- [ ] Directory name matches the project / repo name
- [ ] `Repo` field points to a valid GitHub repository URL
- [ ] `Status` is one of: `In Progress`, `Planned`, `On Hold`, `Completed`
- [ ] `Period` is in `YYYY-MM-DD - YYYY-MM-DD` format (use `TBD` for open-ended end date)
- [ ] The linked repository is accessible with the configured token (if private)
